title: esy manager
noStoresBody: Create your first store on esy.ge and it will appear here.

products.title: Products
products.emptyBody: Add your first product and it goes live on your storefront immediately.

signInRequired: Sign in to manage your stores

settings.shopNote: Shop and brand still share one form. Splitting the fields is a separate job from splitting the navigation.
settings.brandNote: Shop and brand still share one form. Splitting the fields is a separate job from splitting the navigation.

team.title: Team
team.sub: Who can run this store. Store roles are separate from platform administration.
team.empty: Nobody else has a role in this store yet.
team.addHint: The account must have signed in at least once — identities come from Google, so an address nobody has used yet cannot be given a role.
team.removeConfirm: Remove {{email}} from this store? They lose access to the back office; their shopping history is untouched.
team.removeSelfConfirm: Remove your own access to this store? You will not be able to return unless another owner adds you back.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.excludes: Revenue excludes refunded and cancelled orders, and excludes delivery — a courier charge passes through you, not to you. The order count is every order placed.
stats.lifetimeOnly: These are lifetime totals. The 7 / 30 / 90-day windows and the top-products list are designed but not built, so no period selector is shown rather than one that changes nothing.

money.title: Money
money.sub: What you earned, and what the platform charges ({{percent}}% of goods).
money.howBody: {{percent}}% of the goods total is calculated when an order is placed and frozen onto it, so a later rate change never rewrites what you already owe. It is charged on goods alone — never on delivery, and never on an order that was refunded or cancelled.
money.deliveryNote: Delivery you collect is not revenue. It is passed to the courier, and no fee is charged on it.
money.noSettlement: The fee accrues but no statement is sent yet, and there is no payment process behind it. Nothing is owed until that exists.
